headline: A source API response should be boring, inspectable, and safe.
copy: The stub gives the future backend a contract before we choose infrastructure or connect a model.

fields.name: query
fields.note: Keep the original user question visible.

fields.name: primary_source_id
fields.note: Required only when a source is found.

fields.name: citation
fields.note: Use No direct source for unsupported claims.

fields.name: family
fields.note: Separate Veda, Gita, Upanishad, and no-source behavior.

fields.name: confidence
fields.note: Numeric confidence travels with the source packet.

fields.name: rights_state
fields.note: No licensed translation display unless allowed.

fields.name: answer_boundary
fields.note: The backend returns the boundary, not just content.

required.title: Trace visible
required.copy: Every packet has a trace id that can enter an audit log later.

required.title: No-source visible
required.copy: Unsupported claims return source_found false with a reason.

required.title: Reviewer visible
required.copy: Hold and review states stay visible to the answer layer.

records.title: Steady action
records.summary: Supports practical answers about steady action while avoiding promises of guaranteed calm.
records.boundary: Reflection support only; not therapy, ritual instruction, or spiritual command.

records.title: Oppenheimer category correction
records.summary: Corrects the common claim: the famous line is associated with the Gita, not the four Vedas.
records.boundary: Do not call it a direct quote from the four Vedas.

records.title: Gayatri mantra care
records.summary: Useful for source context, but learner-facing practice needs reviewer and rights review.
records.boundary: No ritual instruction, initiation advice, or recitation authority.

records.title: Stewardship and restraint
records.summary: Can support careful answers about possession and restraint if commentary and rights notes are visible.
records.boundary: Do not flatten the verse into wealth advice or productivity advice.

records.title: Unsupported modern overclaim
records.summary: Used to refuse inflated claims when no reviewed source can carry the answer.
records.boundary: Say no reliable reviewed source is present; do not invent validation.

example.answer_boundary: Do not call it a direct quote from the four Vedas.

rules.title: Packets first
rules.copy: The stub returns structured source packets, not final prose.

rules.title: Rights cautious
rules.copy: The response can cite a source without displaying a licensed translation.

rules.title: Hold means hold
rules.copy: A hold packet cannot become a practice instruction.
